# Country and state values do not match {#countries-and-states}

Check the country name used by the account and the state or province allowed for that country.

<CsvGuideContext slug="countries-and-states" />

## Country and state do not agree {#country-and-state-do-not-agree}

**Message looks like**

- `country`
- `state/province`

The wording identifies a matching situation, not a confirmed diagnosis for your account.

**What it means**

Country and state do not agree.

Import context: Customers.

**Check this first**

Check both values and whether Country is exposed.

::: details Show the steps

**Check the saved date or period value**

Use the country name shown in the account's language, or a mapping default when one country applies throughout. Do not assume a SOAP country enumeration or a two-letter code is the value expected by CSV import. For states and provinces, match the configured short name for the selected country. Inspect the account's state/province list when the value looks right but is rejected.

[Country values](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_N454670.html), [state and province values](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_N454550.html)

:::

<CsvEntryHelp entry-id="CUS-05" />

- [Customer Import Errors](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_4568672490.html)

Documentation checked September 16, 2026.

## A country code is not the expected country name {#a-country-code-is-not-the-expected-country-name}

**Message looks like**

- `country`

The wording identifies a matching situation, not a confirmed diagnosis for your account.

**What it means**

A country code may have been supplied where a localized name is expected.

Import context: General imports.

**Check this first**

A country code may have been supplied where a localized name is expected.

::: details Show the steps

**Check the saved date or period value**

Use the country name shown in the account's language, or a mapping default when one country applies throughout. Do not assume a SOAP country enumeration or a two-letter code is the value expected by CSV import. For states and provinces, match the configured short name for the selected country. Inspect the account's state/province list when the value looks right but is rejected.

[Country values](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_N454670.html), [state and province values](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_N454550.html)

:::
